falsifiers.required_discriminator: After one successful recovery with provenance A, a repeat call for the same checkpoint and legacy receipt using provenance B must not silently succeed as an exact idempotent replay. It should fail with an explicit provenance conflict, unless the contract is deliberately changed to define provenance as informational-only for repeats and that weaker semantic is separately reconciled.
falsifiers.rationale: The recovery_id includes recovery_provenance_ref, and the recovery record represents externally witnessed migration authority. Treating a different caller provenance as the same exact recovery while returning the old provenance creates an identity/authorization ambiguity.
